title: ReportSessionWriteResult
description: report.session-write-result@1: what POST /internal/session-reports on OpenVibe.Report answers. ID is the report's id, URL its page (openvibe.report/s/<id>) and CREATED says whether this call stored the report or found the one it had already stored (the route is idempotent per source and task ref).

created.description: True when this call stored the report, false when it was already there.
